Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **London, UK; Dubai - United Arab Emirates; Dublin, Ireland**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in setting up or facilitating a crisis management capability, leading crisis response and delivering crisis management training.
* Experience providing 24/7 on-call support for mission-critical enterprise infrastructure or applications.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Project Management certification, experience creating executive-level briefings, and proficiency in Google Suite products including AI applications.
* Experience in the technology sector with a demonstrated understanding of data centers and technical infrastructure.
* Ability to maintain composure and professionalism while leading cross-functional problem-solving teams through ambiguous crises.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills with a proven ability to engage and influence personnel at all organizational levels.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Crisis and Resilience Regional Manager, you will lead and execute the Crisis Management Program for Google’s Data Centers and Technical Infrastructure (TI), shielding the business from major disruptions. You will proactively identify operational gaps, monitor emerging threats, and maintain critical response infrastructure. Through targeted training and realistic simulation exercises, you will build high-performing, prepared teams. During active incidents, you will serve as the primary leader and coordinator for regional and global response efforts. Post-crisis, you will drive continuous improvement by translating lessons learned into stronger, updated playbooks that safeguard the company’s people, assets, and continuity.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
Ireland: €118000 - €120000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage the implementation, adoption, and continuous risk assessment of the infrastructure crisis management program across site, regional, and global levels while tracking emerging threats.
* Drive the crisis management governance framework, ensuring seamless synchronization with cross-functional partners and alignment across all organizational levels.
* Establish and manage critical communication tools, systems, and resources, while designing tailored training and realistic simulation exercises to pressure-test response plans.
* Serve as the primary point of contact during activations to guide responses, protect assets, ensure effective stakeholder communication, and minimize business disruption.
* Lead post-incident and post-exercise reviews to assess efficacy, document lessons learned, remediate gaps, and partner with adjacent resilience programs for continuous improvement.

**Who we're looking for:**

The Public Cloud Operations Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for supporting and leading Public Cloud operations and Site Reliability Engineering (CloudSRE).

  

This is not a coordination-only role. The successful candidate is expected to remain actively involved in cloud troubleshooting, incident investigation, automation, observability, and technical problem solving while providing day-to-day technical leadership to the CloudSRE team and oversight of managed service providers.

The ideal candidate has a minimum of 4 years of relevant cloud, SRE, or infrastructure operations experience, previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent, and strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS. Experience with GCP and OCI is considered an asset.

**What you'll do:**

Technical Leadership

* Provide hands-on technical leadership to the CloudSRE team, remaining actively engaged in engineering, operational activities, and complex troubleshooting.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for cloud infrastructure, reliability, performance, availability, and major operational issues, leading root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
Establish engineering standards and technical guardrails while mentoring engineers and strengthening the overall technical capability of the CloudSRE team.  

Public Cloud Operations

* Provide hands-on administration, operations, and troubleshooting across Microsoft Azure and AWS, with experience in GCP and/or OCI considered an asset.
* Work across cloud technologies including networking, compute, storage, identity, RBAC/IAM, PaaS services, security, monitoring, backup/recovery, and high availability.
Drive improvements in reliability, security, performance, operational efficiency, and cost, while supporting incident, problem, change, capacity, and availability management.  

SRE & Observability

* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across infrastructure, platform, and application services using logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and service-health telemetry.
* Apply SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, capacity, incident, and problem management to improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Improve alert quality, reduce noise, and use operational telemetry to proactively identify reliability, performance, capacity, and service-health risks, leveraging platforms such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or equivalent.  

Automation & Engineering

* Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them to reduce manual effort, operational risk, and human error using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Leverage Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
Promote an engineering-first approach to cloud operations, driving continuous improvement through automation, standardization, and reusable engineering solutions.  

AI & AIOps

* Drive the practical adoption of AI-assisted operations and AIOps within the CloudSRE team, incorporating AI into day-to-day operational and engineering workflows.
* Apply AI-assisted capabilities to troubleshooting, incident investigation, log analysis, operational analysis, automation, and documentation to accelerate problem resolution.
Identify and implement opportunities where AI agents, AI-assisted engineering tools, and AIOps platforms can reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance service reliability.  

Incident & Problem Management

* Provide technical leadership during high-severity Public Cloud incidents, coordinating troubleshooting across CloudSRE, application teams, Cyber, infrastructure teams, vendors, and cloud service providers.
* Drive effective root-cause analysis and corrective/preventative actions, identifying recurring incidents and implementing engineering, automation, or monitoring solutions to prevent recurrence.
Improve MTTD and MTTR through better observability, automation, runbooks, operational practices, and proactive problem management.  

Vendor Management

* Provide technical oversight and direction to managed service providers and technology vendors, while maintaining internal technical ownership and accountability.
* Review vendor performance including technical deliverables, incident response, SLA adherence, engineering quality, and compliance with established cloud operational standards.
Identify and address vendor capability or performance gaps, challenging technical solutions where appropriate and driving vendors toward sustainable engineering solutions and corrective actions.  

Collaboration & Communication

* Collaborate closely with application teams, infrastructure, Cyber, engineering, service management, vendors, and cloud service providers to deliver reliable Public Cloud services.
* Translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable information for technical, non-technical, and leadership stakeholders, including risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
Provide clear technical direction and coordination during incidents, operational activities, and cross-functional initiatives.

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Public Cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure operations, DevOps, or a related technical discipline.
* Previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, SRE Lead, Cloud Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience.
* Strong cloud troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience with cloud networking, compute, storage, IAM/RBAC, monitoring, security, backup/recovery, and PaaS technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with observability and monitoring technologies and practices.
* Experience with automation and scripting, such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and/or DevOps automation.
* Experience with JIRA/Conflence
* Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience leading or participating in high-severity incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
* Experience providing technical direction or oversight to third-party vendors or managed service providers.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GCP and/or OCI.
* Experience with Dynatrace or comparable enterprise observability platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container platforms such as AKS, EKS, or GKE.
* Experience implementing SRE practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and service-health metrics.
* Experience with AI-assisted operations, AIOps, AI agents, or AI-enabled troubleshooting and automation.
Relevant Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, or SRE certifications are considered an asset.

Title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager
Description:
Cloud Infrastructure Manager
  
**The role**

Lead the cloud infrastructure that runs myZoi’s production platforms across AWS and Azure, keeping them reliable, secure, scalable and cost-effective.

This is a player-coach role. You will manage the DevOps and SRE team while staying hands-on in design, implementation and incident response, with particular depth in cloud and infrastructure networking.

You will own the infrastructure roadmap, operational performance and delivery of improvements. You will work closely with Architecture, Engineering, Cybersecurity and Technology Operations to support business growth and maintain service continuity.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Team leadership
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the DevOps and SRE team; set clear objectives and manage performance.
* Plan priorities across operational work, improvements and projects, with clear owners, milestones and escalation of risks.
* Build on-call arrangements, backup coverage and knowledge sharing so no service depends on a single engineer; take part in the escalation rota.
* Report proactively on service health, delivery progress, costs and material risks.

Hands-on infrastructure and networking
  
  
  

* Design, build and operate cloud networking across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet design, hub-and-spoke or transit topologies, routing, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints and hybrid connectivity (VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).
* Implement network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, security groups and NSGs, WAF and secure ingress and egress.
* Build and operate compute, storage, managed databases and Kubernetes platforms, with clear segregation of production and non-production environments.
* Write and review Terraform, and set standards for configuration management, patching and lifecycle management using version control, peer review and automated checks.
* Develop infrastructure designs with Architecture and implement the agreed standards.
* Lead the technical planning and execution of migrations and infrastructure transitions, including testing, cutover, rollback and handover.

DevOps and reliability
  
  
  

* Oversee infrastructure automation, deployment tooling and CI/CD in partnership with Engineering.
* Improve monitoring, observability and actionable alerting; agree service-level objectives with service owners.
* Own infrastructure-level escalation and restoration during incidents, then drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
* Maintain capacity and performance plans aligned with expected demand.

Backup and disaster recovery
  
  
  

* Own infrastructure backup, restore and recovery mechanisms.
* Plan and run recovery tests with Technology Operations and application owners, validating agreed RTO and RPO targets.

Security and compliance
  
  
  

* Implement cloud security controls in line with Cybersecurity policies, including identity and privileged access, encryption, logging and secrets management.
* Ensure vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses are remediated within agreed timelines.
* Apply regulatory, data-residency and contractual requirements to infrastructure, with guidance from the responsible functions.
* Maintain current infrastructure documentation, recovery procedures and auditable records of access, changes, control operation and test results; support internal and external reviews.

Cost and supplier management
  
  
  

* Manage cloud spend within approved budgets, with transparent allocation, forecasting and reporting.
* Drive cost optimisation through rightsizing, commitment-based purchasing and removal of unused resources.
* Manage the technical performance of cloud and infrastructure suppliers, supporting commercial decisions with Finance and Procurement.

Experience and capabilities
  

* Typically 8 or more years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps or related disciplines, including at least 3 years managing engineers.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams that run business-critical production services, while remaining hands-on.
* Strong hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. Experience with cross-cloud migration is advantageous.
* Deep networking expertise across cloud and hybrid environments: TCP/IP, routing, subnetting, DNS, load balancing, VPN and private connectivity, firewalls and segmentation, and troubleshooting complex connectivity issues.
* Practical expertise in identity and access management, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability.
* Experience with disaster recovery testing, major incidents, infrastructure security and cost optimisation.
* Ability to challenge technical proposals, prioritise competing demands and explain decisions in clear business terms.
* Proven delivery through internal teams and external suppliers, with effective delegation and proactive escalation.
* Financial-services, payments or other regulated-sector experience is preferred.

Qualifications
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant AWS, Azure, Terraform or Kubernetes certifications are desirable.
* Networking certifications (for example AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate or CCNP) are a plus.
* Familiarity with ITIL and recognised security frameworks is advantageous.

Title: Problem & Incident Manager

East West Bank is seeking an experienced Problem & Incident Manager to join the Network Operations Center (NOC) organization and lead Problem Management practices across the enterprise. * Maintain a repository of Known Errors, Workarounds, and Problem Records.

* Monitor incidents through resolution and ensure all actions are documented within the ITSM platform.
* Establish and continually improve Major Incident Management procedures, playbooks, and escalation processes.

* Analyze operational trends and provide recommendations for continual improvement.
* Assist leadership with creation and analysis of operational reports, service metrics, and executive dashboards.
* Support regulatory, audit, risk management, and compliance reporting requirements.

* Support monitoring, escalation, and coordination activities for critical production environments.
* Participate in operational readiness reviews, maintenance planning, disaster recovery exercises, and change risk assessments.
* Assist with service restoration activities involving cloud services, enterprise infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, and business applications.
* Support incident response activities impacting Azure, Microsoft 365, networking, telecommunications, voice systems, and enterprise platforms.

**Compliance, Governance & Risk Management**

* Ensure all Incident and Problem Management activities comply with bankingregulatory expectations including FDIC, SEC, FFIEC, SOX, and internal audit requirements.
* Maintain complete documentation and evidentiary records supporting audits and examinations.
* Participate in regulatory reviews, audits, and operational risk assessments as required.
* Promote adherence to ITSM governance frameworks, operational controls, and service management best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in Problem and Incident Management, Major Incident Management, NOC Operations or Technology Operations.
* Experience leading enterprise-wide incident response involving multiple technology teams.
* Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis and managing corrective action programs.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) concepts including Incident, Problem, Change, and Major Incident Management.
* Experience with Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar ITSM platforms.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Familiarity with FFIEC, FDIC, SOX, and regulatory technology controls.
* Knowledge of cloud, network, server, storage, and end-user computing environments.

* Reduction in repeat incidents and chronic service disruptions.
* Timely completion of Root Cause Analyses and corrective actions.
* Effective management of Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents.
* Increased service reliability and availability across critical banking platforms.
* Strong audit and regulatory compliance outcomes.
* Improved executive visibility into operational risks and service health.
* Mature and measurable Incident and Problem Management practices aligned with ITIL best practices.

Title: Lead ICT Engineer - Data Centers
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Lead ICT Engineer is responsible for leading the Information and Communications Technology engineering scope of Digital EPC projects from concept and detailed design through procurement, construction, systems integration, testing, commissioning and final handover. The role ensures that ICT infrastructure, telecommunications systems, data-centre connectivity, structured cabling, active networks, wireless solutions and unified communications platforms are secure, resilient, scalable and aligned with project and operational requirements.

The position provides discipline leadership for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications hubs, smart buildings, command-and-control centres and other technology-intensive developments. The Lead ICT Engineer coordinates engineers, designers, specialist consultants, OEMs, vendors, construction teams, systems integrators and client representatives while managing interfaces with power, cooling, ELV, security, BMS, DCIM and commissioning functions.

The role safeguards engineering quality and connectivity resilience through disciplined architecture governance, capacity planning, cybersecurity integration, equipment specification, vendor review, configuration control and change management. It resolves complex technical issues and ensures that ICT systems support integrated testing, operational readiness, business continuity and long-term maintainability.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. ICT Engineering Leadership**

Lead planning, execution and technical assurance of the ICT engineering scope, establishing architecture principles, delivery priorities, resource requirements, design schedules and quality expectations.

**2. ICT Infrastructure Architecture**

Develop and govern end-to-end ICT architecture covering data networks, structured cabling, telecommunications, wireless connectivity, data-centre infrastructure and unified communications.

**3. Network & Connectivity Engineering**

Lead design of LAN, WAN, WLAN, fiber-optic backbones, campus networks, internet connectivity and mission-critical communications, ensuring capacity, redundancy, availability and scalability.

**4. Structured Cabling & Passive Infrastructure**

Direct design and coordination of copper and fiber structured cabling, pathways, containment, equipment rooms, racks, cabinets, patching, labeling, testing and certification requirements.

**5. Telecommunications & Unified Communications**

Provide technical leadership for IP telephony, unified communications, video collaboration, operational communications and associated telecom infrastructure and interfaces.

**6. Cybersecurity & Network Resilience Integration**

Embed segmentation, secure architecture, access control, redundancy, monitoring, hardening and cybersecurity requirements into ICT designs in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

**7. Vendor & Procurement Engineering**

Prepare and review specifications, datasheets, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, vendor documents, deviations and clarifications for ICT equipment, software, licensing and services.

**8. Multidiscipline & Systems Integration Coordination**

Manage interfaces with ELV, security, audiovisual, BMS, DCIM, power, cooling, civil, architectural, construction and commissioning disciplines to deliver integrated solutions.

**9. Construction, Testing & Commissioning Support**

Resolve technical queries and field issues and lead readiness for factory and site testing, cable certification, network validation, failover testing, integrated systems testing and defect closure.

**10. Documentation, Handover & Team Development**

Ensure completion of configurations, asset records, as-built drawings, test evidence, operating manuals, training and handover documentation while guiding ICT engineers and designers

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

**ICT Engineering Experience: Minimum 12+ years in design and project delivery**

Progressive experience in ICT networks, telecommunications, structured cabling and digital infrastructure for data centres, smart buildings, transport, utilities or technology-intensive EPC projects.

**Discipline Leadership Experience: Minimum 5+ years leading ICT engineering teams**

Demonstrated responsibility for architecture, technical deliverables, equipment packages, vendor coordination, multidisciplinary interfaces, systems integration and engineering quality.

**Digital EPC & Commissioning Experience: Minimum 5+ years across procurement, construction and testing**

Experience translating ICT requirements into vendor packages, installation deliverables, configurations, testing procedures and operational-handover solutions.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

**1. Enterprise Network Architecture**

Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, network segmentation, redundancy, availability and capacity planning for complex digital environments.

**2. Structured Cabling & Data-Centre Connectivity**

Strong understanding of copper and fiber cabling, pathways, spaces, racks, cabinets, patching, labeling, testing, certification and data-centre connectivity principles.

**3. Telecommunications & Unified Communications**

Knowledge of IP telephony, unified communications, video collaboration, operational communications and related infrastructure, protocols and integration requirements.

**4. Cybersecurity, Configuration & Systems Integration**

Ability to incorporate secure architecture, access controls, monitoring, configuration management and interfaces with ELV, BMS, DCIM, security and operational systems.

**5. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

Strong analytical, communication and decision-making capability to resolve complex ICT issues, lead technical teams and align clients, consultants, OEMs and integrators.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline

• Professional Engineering registration, chartered status, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

• Relevant advanced networking certification such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent strongly preferred

• Relevant certification in structured cabling, data centres, wireless, unified communications, cybersecurity, or project management advantageous

• Training in applicable international ICT standards, systems integration, HSE, or quality management preferred

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

**Enterprise Network Design:**

Designs and reviews resilient LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, segmentation, addressing, capacity and high-availability architectures.

**Structured Cabling & Fiber Infrastructure:**

Leads design and verification of copper and fiber systems, containment, equipment rooms, racks, labeling, testing and certification.

**Telecommunications & Unified Communications:**

Engineers IP telephony, collaboration, video, operational communications and associated platform and connectivity requirements.

**Cybersecurity & Configuration Governance:**

Applies secure architecture, access control, hardening, monitoring, configuration, change and technical-documentation controls throughout delivery.

**Testing, Commissioning & Systems Integration:**

Develops and governs test plans, network validation, failover testing, integrated systems testing, defect resolution and operational acceptance.

Title: Major Incident Manager, Incident Management -TikTok USDS
Description:
**Responsibilities**
The USDS JV Incident Management Team (IMT) is a critical pillar within the US Tech and Product organization, dedicated to ensuring the resilience and reliability of TikTok’s U.S. Data Security infrastructure. As a security-first division, we focus on providing specialized oversight and protection for U.S. user data and the platforms that support them.
  
While global teams monitor overall service health, the IMT is uniquely positioned to manage the "blast radius" within the USDS environment. We act as the bridge between technical engineering teams (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform) and business stakeholders, ensuring that every major incident is handled with the precision and urgency required by our unique operating environment.
  
  
As a Major Incident Manager, you will be at the forefront of protecting the TikTok experience for millions of users. You will join a cohesive, proficient team committed to upholding the highest standards of professionalism and technical expertise, directly contributing to the safety and security of the U.S. digital ecosystem.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Incident Command: Lead the end-to-end response for high-severity incidents, driving rapid restoration of service while coordinating across cross-functional engineering teams.
  
- Stakeholder Communication: Craft and deliver clear, timely, and accurate communication updates to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and customer-facing teams during critical events.
  
- Post-Incident Reviews: Facilitate blameless post-mortems, ensuring root causes are thoroughly identified, actionable remediation items are tracked, and lessons learned are shared globally.
  
- Dashboarding & Visibility: Create and maintain real-time operational dashboards that provide high visibility into system health, incident trends, and key reliability metrics (MTTD/MTTR).
  
- Continuous Improvement: Analyze incident data and operational metrics to identify systemic trends, driving initiatives to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
  
- Team Process Evolution: Manage and optimize the incident management rotation, refining playbooks, alerting thresholds, and escalation pathways for the SRE org.
  
- Alerting & Monitoring Improvements: Partner with SRE and development teams to continuously refine alert thresholds, reduce alert fatigue, and ensure high-severity pages are highly actionable.
  
- Automation Engineering: Design and build automated workflows to streamline incident response, such as automated stakeholder communications, auto-remediation scripts, and tool integrations.
  
- Oncall Support: The Incident Management team operates 24x5x365 with on-call rotation during weekends. This position is for the Sunday to Thursday shift, from 5 PM PT to 2 AM PT.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) with 4+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern infrastructure architectures (microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
  
- Hands-on experience configuring and refining alerts and monitoring templates using industry-standard tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, New Relic).
  
- Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) or use low-code integration tools to automate repetitive incident management tasks and notification pipelines.
  
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.
  
- Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident management frameworks or modern DevOps/SRE incident response practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- 5+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Deep alignment with Google SRE principles, including Error Budgets, SLA/SLO/SLI management, and automation-first mindsets.
  
- Proven experience implementing ChatOps, auto-remediation workflows, or Event-Driven Ansible/Runbook automation to programmatically resolve common alerts.
  
- Advanced proficiency with modern incident orchestration platforms like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, JIRA Service Management, and Slack integrations.
  
- Experience using SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools to build operational dashboards and report on organizational reliability metrics.
  
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL v4, AWS/GCP Certified Professional, or Certified Incident Commander.
  
- Experience coaching and training engineering teams on best practices for on-call hygiene and conducting constructive post-mortems.

Title: Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity
Description:
**DT One | Dubai | Full-time**
**About Us**
DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity who is passionate about protecting platforms that move money and value in real time, and who wants to shape how security and infrastructure are run across a fast-growing, global business. As part of the Technology leadership team, you will own the security strategy, reference architecture and roadmap for DT One, and lead the team that builds and runs our infrastructure and security controls day to day.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Our platform processes millions of transactions every month, connects thousands of partners across 190 countries and runs 24/7 on AWS. That means our infrastructure must be resilient, our identities and privileged access tightly governed, our edge protected, and our security operations able to detect and respond quickly, while meeting the expectations of payment schemes, regulators, auditors and investors in every market we operate in.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction with the senior leadership team and act as design authority for new platforms, while staying close enough to the engineering to lead major programmes yourself, such as zero-trust access, SIEM modernisation and security as code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, technically excellent security and infrastructure leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own how DT One's infrastructure is designed, secured and operated, from the network edge and cloud landing zone through to identity, endpoints and the security operations centre.
  
  

* Define and own the security strategy, reference architectures and multi-year roadmap, working with senior leadership; run security assessments and gap analyses across the business to prioritise the controls that matter most
* Act as security design authority, reviewing and approving the architecture of new products, platforms and partner integrations so that security is designed in from the start
* Own the cloud and infrastructure security posture on AWS (and any multi-cloud footprint), including landing zone design, guardrails, CSPM, CIS hardening and security Infrastructure as Code in Terraform
* Lead network and edge security, including WAF, DDoS protection, DNS, next-generation firewalls, micro-segmentation and network access control, and drive the move to zero-trust network access in place of legacy VPN
* Own identity and access management: identity architecture, SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA and passwordless, Conditional Access, privileged access management, identity governance and automated joiner-mover-leaver processes
* Lead security operations and the SOC, including SIEM strategy and migration, log source onboarding, detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, ingestion cost optimisation, audit logging and incident response
* Run endpoint and vulnerability management across the estate, including EDR, MDM/MAM, patching, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing and remediation with engineering teams
* Lead PCI-DSS compliance and recertification, and align our controls to ISO 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls
* Lead the security workstream for audits, partner assessments, M&A and investor due diligence, and maintain clear security architecture documentation for executives, auditors and the Board
* Set governance for the safe use of AI and generative-AI services across the business, including technical controls on unapproved tools
* Own the infrastructure and security budget: build business cases for new controls and technologies, lead vendor selection and proofs of concept, and manage a multi-vendor environment
* Build, lead and develop a team across infrastructure security, IAM, security operations and SOC, including hiring, performance management and career development

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience across infrastructure, networking and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years leading security architecture, engineering or operations teams
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience in payments or fintech
* Proven track record of setting security strategy and reference architectures with a CISO or CTO, and acting as design authority for new platforms
* Track record of building infrastructure and security functions from the ground up, including standing up the full IT, network and security stack for a new business at pace
* Deep hands-on expertise in network and edge security (for example Cloudflare, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco), with a strong routing, switching and core network foundation
* Hands-on cloud security experience on AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including landing zones, CSPM and security Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
* Experience delivering zero-trust network access programmes (for example Zscaler ZPA) at scale
* Strong identity and privileged access experience, for example Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, PAM platforms such as One Identity Safeguard, and IGA platforms such as Saviynt
* Experience leading SOC teams and SIEM platforms (for example Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, IBM QRadar), including platform migrations and log ingestion cost optimisation
* Experience leading PCI-DSS certification and maintaining compliance through annual recertification
* Working knowledge of CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF and ISO 27001
* Experience owning budgets, running vendor selection and explaining risk and trade-offs clearly to senior business leaders, auditors and investors
* Expert-level professional certification such as CCIE, CISSP or equivalent; CEH or vendor security certifications are a plus
* Comfortable using AI-assisted engineering to deliver faster, and interested in the security of AI services
* Fluent Arabic and English, spoken and written (essential)
* Interest in the Fintech industry and market innovations

We can offer you an environment with a culture of learning and feedback. You will have real ownership of the security and infrastructure of a platform that is used 24/7 around the world and needs to be reliable, secure and massively scalable. You will work with technology teams in different countries, and our environment and packages match the ambition of the company: building world-class engineering teams.
  
  
**Sound like you? Apply now!**

Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.
* Manage technical and operational incidents at the property, including the implementation of emergency response procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root-cause analysis and post event remediation.
* Identify trends and analyze risks to articulate implications and impact to data center operations. Track operational metrics and other data to provide Senior Management oversight and control for both snapshot data and long-term trend analysis.
* Identify process based improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies including the development and presentation of the business case.
* Support Property Manager with the management of expenses and assist all budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements by providing capital and expense requirements and justifications.
* Support pre-sales process, including, but not limited to, conducting sales tours and reviewing lease proposals and lease agreements to confirm compliance with Digital Realty standards and local requirements.
* Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by Digital Realty.
* Maintain compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes.

**What you’ll need**

* 10 years related facility management experience in data center operations (or related electrical or mechanical engineering field) with minimum of 5 years’ experience managing or leading data center operations teams in a large scale mission critical environment. Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering preferred.
* Solid and proven experience in the construction, commissioning, acceptance and operation of mission critical systems, including state-of-the-art electrical distribution systems, static and rotary UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression and monitoring systems
* Extensive knowledge of structured cabling systems, networking and connectivity standards, and hardware installation requirements.
* Proficient experience in colocation operations, including the installation and deployment of cage, rack and cable infrastructure, as well as, power circuit installation and power monitoring.
* Experience working with and deploying telecom and network providers, specifically in Meet Me Room and POP room environments
* Experience managing a change control environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.
* Knowledge of industry data center standards, policies & methodologies
* Knowledge of performance management & critical awareness methods and implementation standards
* Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented
* Experience managing own budget and analyzing expenses
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio or AutoCad
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering system

**A bit about us**

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

  

**Operations**

Our Operations team keeps our customers’ infrastructure running safely and securely. We get plenty of opportunities to take on a variety of tasks and develop our technical skills. From overseeing electrical power to cooling and fire suppression systems, our team plays a vital role in making sure everything in our data centers operates as it should.

  

**What we can offer you**

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

  

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

  

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

  

**Health and Safety**

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

  

**Our Compensation Philosophy**

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

Title: Oracle Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**About Centroid**
Centroid helps organizations modernize, operate, and support mission-critical business systems across Oracle and multi-cloud environments. We provide advisory, deployment, migration, integration, and managed services, with a focus on strong client service, dependable delivery, and career growth for our employees.
  
  
Travel: up to 10%
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Centroid is seeking a Service Delivery Manager (SDM) to lead assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts. This role is responsible for client satisfaction, service quality, account health, financial performance, and responsible growth. The SDM serves as the primary service management contact for clients and works closely with technical teams, leadership, and internal stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with scope, service commitments, and client expectations.
  
  
This is a client-facing delivery leadership role, not a hands-on technical administration role. The ideal candidate is organized, accountable, comfortable working through matrixed global teams, and able to manage priorities, risks, escalations, and follow-through in a fast-paced managed services environment.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Success in this role requires more than experience. We are looking for candidates who can share real examples that demonstrate the following traits:
  
  

* Flexibility: Adapts quickly when priorities, client needs, or delivery constraints change.
* Process-driven and organized: Uses structure, follow-up routines, and clear communication to keep work moving.
* Intrinsically motivated: Takes initiative, follows through, and looks for ways to improve outcomes.
* Interested in learning and growing: Is coachable, curious, and open to learning Centroid’s way of working.
* Accountable: Owns commitments, raises risks early, and closes the loop with clients and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client Leadership and Account Health
  
  

* Lead the overall health of assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts, including client satisfaction, retention, service quality, profitability, and responsible growth.
* Run the regular client and internal cadence, including monthly reviews, QBRs, risk reviews, decision tracking, and follow-up actions.
* Communicate performance, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities clearly to client and Centroid leadership.

Service Delivery and Governance
  
  

* Oversee service delivery across assigned accounts, technologies, and global teams while staying within SOWs, SLAs, procedures, and Centroid standards.
* Set up practical account governance, including meeting cadence, reporting, escalation paths, roles, responsibilities, and decision processes.
* Coordinate with technical, service desk, security, consulting, vendor, and leadership teams to keep work moving and handoffs clear.

Service Operations, Transitions, and Escalations
  
  

* Lead coordination and client communication during incidents, escalations, outages, maintenance windows, production changes, and other high-priority situations.
* Keep ownership clear, drive the communication rhythm, confirm recovery, and make sure RCA and corrective actions are completed.
* Support transitions into Cloud Managed Services by confirming scope, SLAs, resources, access, documentation, knowledge transfer, monitoring, ticket routing, and readiness.

Financial Management
  
  

* Manage account financial health, including budget, revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, billing readiness, and financial risk.
* Watch demand and scope, identify out-of-scope work early, and support change orders, renewals, profitability improvements, and account planning.

Resource Leadership
  
  

* Lead onshore and offshore delivery teams supporting 24x7 operations while partnering with technical managers who own direct people management.
* Plan for capacity, identify coverage or skill gaps, coordinate assignments, improve handoffs, and coach teams on communication, documentation, escalation, and follow-through.

Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk
  
  

* Ensure assigned accounts follow Centroid’s security, privacy, access-management, audit, data-handling, and compliance requirements.
* Track evidence and follow-up for access approvals, onboarding, offboarding, controls, audit requests, security findings, patching needs, and other risks.

Reporting, Continuous Improvement, and Growth
  
  

* Provide clear reporting on SLAs, ticket trends, incidents, changes, availability, risks, projects, utilization, financials, and improvement actions.
* Use service data to spot recurring issues, process gaps, automation opportunities, and practical service improvements.
* Partner with Sales, Consulting, solution architects, and leadership on renewals, proposals, service expansion, and opportunities that create client value.

Additional Expectations
  
  
This is a remote position with limited travel. The SDM must be able to support client escalations, global team coordination, maintenance windows, and time-sensitive issues across time zones.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10+ years of enterprise IT or technology services experience, including 3 to 5 years leading service delivery, client accounts, operations, projects, or matrixed teams.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, SLA-based services, ITSM processes, governance, escalations, financials, utilization, scope, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and manage customer-facing service-delivery work.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to turn complex technical and operational information into clear business communication and action plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or higher; PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or another service or project management credential is helpful.
* Experience with a Managed Services Provider supporting 24x7 enterprise operations and Oracle application, database, integration, infrastructure, or engineered-system services.
* Working knowledge of OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, hybrid environments, monitoring, patching, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, security, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, OpenAir, or similar platforms, plus experience with executive reviews, renewals, and service-growth opportunities.

Why Join Centroid
  
  
At Centroid, you will work with experienced teams, support meaningful client outcomes, and grow your career in a collaborative Cloud Managed Services environment. This role offers the opportunity to lead important client relationships, strengthen delivery practices, and make a visible impact across clients and internal teams.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Network Build
Description:
**Brief Description**
Senior Program Manager, Network Build
  
  
**HELP CONNECT ARIZONA. BUILD THE FUTURE OF BROADBAND**
.
  
  
At Wecom Fiber, we're helping bridge the digital divide across Arizona by building and maintaining the communications infrastructure that powers homes, businesses, schools, and communities. As our next Senior Manager of Field Operations Support, you'll play a key leadership role in scaling operations, improving performance, and helping shape the future of a rapidly growing telecommunications organization.
  
  
**WHY WECOM?**
At Wecom, we believe exceptional people deserve more than a paycheck.
  
  
We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.
  
  
**Department:**
Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Location:**
Arizona – Statewide (Field/Hybrid)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Program Manager, Network Build leads the delivery of fiber network construction across one or more markets and the Design Areas within them. This role owns the plan for each market from an accepted design package through an operational network, and is accountable for keeping every Design Area moving through the same sixteen milestones, from package accepted to operational. The Senior Program Manager sets the standard for how the Network Build Program Managers plan, report and escalate, and is the primary voice of the build program to senior leaders. The role also helps build and refine the processes the team runs on, so that planning, handoffs, reporting and vendor payment become more consistent and more efficient as the program grows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Plan and schedule ownership**

* Own the schedule and plan logic for assigned markets, including dependencies, crew capacity, quantities, production rates and weather effects, and keep them accurate as work moves from Project Controls to the Network Build team.
* Maintain the sixteen-milestone plan for every Design Area, and decide when a milestone is complete using evidence from the responsible team rather than assumption.
* Re-forecast dates when crew counts, weather, permits or materials change, and explain the effect on the market finish date.

**Milestone management and handoffs**

* Confirm the Operational state of each Design Area. The Senior Program Manager and the Network Build Program Managers confirm it; no other team does.
* Manage the release of each project to construction, including the handoff to Supply Chain for materials staging and the notice to Sales and Marketing.
* In Prescott, run the pre-construction approval sequence: Construction completes the utility locates and reports to the Program Manager, the Program Manager schedules the pre-construction walks, Design and Engineering makes comments and corrections, the City approves, and Construction is then released.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate Design and Engineering, the Permit Specialist, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center so that each handoff is clean and dated.
* Hold a weekly meeting with each team on Thursday or Friday, collect final updates by Monday, and prepare the reports for the Wednesday 30-60-90 day review.
* Escalate risks, delays and decisions early, with a recommendation and the effect on schedule and cost.

**Vendor and financial oversight**

* Make sure construction vendors are paid accurately and on time by reviewing each submitted invoice against the approved design prints before it is entered for payment.
* Track budget against forecast for each Design Area and flag variances to leadership.

**Reporting and governance**

* Report status using four labels: On Track, At-Risk, Off-Track and Complete.
* Track grant-funded markets against their commitments and prepare the reporting those programs require.
* Review the plan data for accuracy each week, and correct gaps before reports are issued.
* Communicate directly with executives and senior leaders in writing and in meetings, presenting status, risks, decisions and recommendations in plain language with the conclusion first.

**Team leadership**

* Coach and review the work of the Network Build Program Managers, set consistent reporting standards, and step in on the most complex or at-risk markets.

**Process development and improvement**

* Help design and document the processes the Network Build team follows, including milestone definitions, handoffs between teams, schedule updates, reporting and vendor invoice review.
* Review how the processes work in practice each quarter, identify recurring delays, rework and gaps, and recommend and lead improvements.
* Turn lessons from completed Design Areas into updated standards, templates and checklists that every Network Build Program Manager uses.
* Work with Design and Engineering, Permitting, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center to agree on process changes before they are adopted.
* Train and coach the Network Build Program Managers on new and revised processes, and confirm that they are followed.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least eight years of program or project management experience, including at least five years delivering outside plant fiber, utility or telecommunications construction.
* Demonstrated ability to manage schedules with dependencies, crew capacity and weather, and to explain a forecast change in plain language.
* Experience managing construction vendors, including invoice review against design documents.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting executive-level status reports, briefings and recommendations that are clear, accurate and concise.

**Preferred**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience with federal or state broadband grant programs.
* Experience with permitting for rights-of-way, railroad, highway and utility pole attachments.
* Experience leading or mentoring other program managers.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Every Design Area in the assigned markets shows an accurate, current date for each milestone.

Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.

Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.

**Contractor Performance Management**

Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery

**Commercial and Cost Management**

Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.

**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**

Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.

**What Success Looks Like**

Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)

**Experience**

8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.

**Skills That Matter**

Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Title: Senior Network Services Engineer (IT Infrastructure Engineer 3) - Provisional
Description:
Senior Network Services Engineer (IT Infrastructure Engineer 3) - Provisional

**GENERAL DUTIES**

This position encompasses professional and responsible highly technical consultative and/or administrative work unique to the design and engineering of complex datacenters, networks and cloud deployments. Under administrative direction of a university IT manager, with broad latitude for independent action or decision, is responsible for the development of comprehensive infrastructure solutions. Engineer and operate mission critical infrastructure and be responsible for the access and protection of sensitive data, systems, and networks. May lead a team or participate in a team in planning, designing, implementing, and maintaining datacenter and cloud operations that includes the management of IT facilities, network, security, telecommunications, servers, storage, and virtualization components.

There are three Levels of this title. Assignment Levels 2 and 3 may oversee multiple projects and supervise employees. This specification describes typical assignments for this title; related duties may be assigned as needed.

To view the complete job description, go tohttp://www.cuny.edu/about/administration/offices/hr/classified-civil-service/ccsjobs/and view the Job Description for **IT Infrastructure Engineer.**

**CONTRACT TITLE**

IT Infrastructure Engineer

**FLSA**

Non-exempt

**CAMPUS SPECIFIC INFORMATION**

The Office of Computing and Information Services (CIS) at the City University of New York (CUNY) supports the IT and telecommunications needs of CUNY's 26 colleges. CIS supports enterprise IT and applications, identifies and develops new technologies that advance the University's core mission, operates and maintains the University's network, the enterprise Data Center, and the CUNY Service Desk. Additionally, CIS manages the processes that safeguard the University’s IT assets and maintains the security posture by operating the CUNY Security Operations Center (SOC), develops disaster recovery plans for business continuity, and supports the CUNYfirst Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions that integrate student administration, financial management, and human resources operations across CUNY’s 26 colleges. Lastly, CIS provides strategic and operational IT leadership to all CUNY campuses.

Reporting to the Director of Network Services, the Senior Network Services Engineer designs, implements, operates, and optimizes secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions, provides technical leadership for complex projects and major incidents and supports network modernization, automation, cloud connectivity, and infrastructure resiliency initiatives. The position supports the University’s enterprise network infrastructure and shared technology services and provides senior-level engineering expertise across CUNY’s WAN/MAN, core and campus networks, optical transport, datacenter networking, wireless infrastructure, network security, cloud connectivity, and network automation. The Sr. Network Services Engineer also develops engineering and operational documentation and provides technical guidance to engineers and Network Operations Center personnel.

Key duties include, but are not limited to the following:

* Designs, engineers, implements, and operates highly available enterprise network infrastructure, including core routing and switching, WAN/MAN, optical transport, dark-fiber interconnects, wireless networks, and datacenter network fabrics.
* Engineers and maintains modern datacenter architectures and services, including spine-leaf fabrics, VXLAN/EVPN, network virtualization, application delivery/load balancing, DNS/DHCP, and enterprise IP Address Management (IPAM).
* Architects and implements secure network segmentation, access controls, and enterprise network security technologies, including VRFs, VLANs, firewalls, TACACS+, RADIUS, Cisco ISE, and Zero Trust principles.
* Engineers and integrates hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity across on-premises infrastructure and public cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Develops and implements network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code capabilities using APIs, configuration templates, source control, CI/CD pipelines, Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), and NetDevOps practices; implements and maintains enterprise routing and switching technologies and protocols, including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, IPv4/IPv6, QoS, and related technologies.
* Provides senior-level technical leadership and escalation support for complex network incidents, including packet and traffic-flow analysis, troubleshooting, service restoration, root cause analysis, and post-incident problem management.
* Implements and maintains network monitoring, observability, telemetry, capacity management, configuration compliance, and AIOps capabilities to improve availability and performance; engineers and maintains resilient network architectures supporting high availability, business continuity, and disaster recovery, including scheduled resiliency and recovery testing.
* Establishes and maintains enterprise network engineering standards, reference architectures, configuration baselines, HLDs/LLDs, MOPs, SOPs, network diagrams, operational runbooks, and other technical documentation.
* Provides technical leadership for university-wide network modernization and service consolidation initiatives; collaborates with cybersecurity, systems, cloud, DevSecOps, telecommunications, and campus technology teams.
* Develops and reviews technical specifications and Statements of Work (SOWs); evaluates proposed technologies and vendor solutions; and provides technical guidance including CUNY change management process, peer review, and mentoring to engineering and operations personnel.

**NOTES:**

* Until further notice, this position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule.

* **An appointment to this Competitive title/position in the Classified Civil Service Title Series will be made with a Provisional status. Employees in provisional status must pass a competitive civil service examination and be appointed from a civil service list to remain in the title/position.**

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**1.** A baccalaureate degree in computer science, engineering or a related field from an accredited college or university **and** five (5) years of satisfactory full-time experience in thedesign and engineering of complex datacenters, networks and/or cloud deployments; **or**

**2.** A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university **and** six (6) years of satisfactory full-time experience as described in “1” above; **or**

**3.** A high school diploma or its educational equivalent **and** ten (10) years of satisfactory full-time experience as described in “1” above; **or**

**4.** Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1," "2" or "3" above. The following may substitute for some of the required experience required in "1," "2" or "3" above, as follows:

College education (undergraduate credits) may substitute for up to four (4) years of the required experience in "3" above on the following basis:

**A.** 30 to 59.9 semester credits substitute for 1 year of experience; **or**

**B.** 60 to 89.9 semester credits substitute for 2 years of experience; **or**

**C.** 90 to 119.9 semester credits substitute for 3 years of experience; **or**

**D.** 120 or more semester credits substitute for 4 years of experience.

Graduate credits in information technology, computer science or a related field may substitute for up to two (2) years of experience in "1" or "2" above on the following basis:

**A.** 15 to 29.9 graduate credits substitute for 1 year of required experience; **or**

**B.** 30 or more graduate credits substitute for 2 years of required experience.

Each of the following validcurrent certification(s) may substitute for one (1) year of the required experience in "1," "2" or "3" above:

**A.** Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) issued by ISC2; **and/or**

**B.** Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) issued by Scrum Alliance; **and/or**

**C.** Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) issued by Cisco; **and/or**

**D.** Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) issued by Cisco; **and/or**

**E.** CompTIA Linux+ issued by CompTIA; **and/or**

**F.** CompTIA Network+ issued by CompTIA; **and/or**

**G.** Security+ issued by CompTIA; **and/or**

**H.** IBM Certified Solution Architect – Cloud Pak for Data issued by IBM; **and/or**

**I.** ITIL Foundation Certification issued by Axelos; **and/or**

**J.** Juniper Networks Certified Internet Associate (JNCIA) issued by Juniper Networks; **and/or**

**K.** Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate issued by Microsoft; **and/or**

**L.** NetApp Certified Data Administrator (NCDA) issued by any authorized organization approved by NetApp; **and/or**

**M.** NetApp Certified Storage Installation Engineer (NCSIE) issued by any authorized organization approved by NetApp; **and/or**

**N.** NetApp Certified Storage Installation Engineer (NCSIE) issued by any authorized organization approved by NetApp; **and/or**

**O.** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional Certification issued by Oracle; **and/or**

**P.** Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) issued by Red Hat; **and/or**

**Q.** VMware Certified Professional (VCP) issued by VMware.

**However, all** **candidates must have a high school diploma or its educational equivalent and at least three (3) years of experience as described in “1” above.**

**Assignment Level II or III**

**Level II:** After meeting the Qualification Requirements above, an additional two (2) years of satisfactory full-time experience in thedesign and engineering of complex datacenters, networks and/or cloud deployments is required for Level II.

**Level III:** After meeting the Qualification Requirements aboveandthe Level II requirements, an additional two (2) years of satisfactory full-time experience in thedesign and engineering of complex datacenters, networks and/or cloud deployments is required for Level III (for a total of 4 years of experience above the Qualification Requirements).

**English Language Proficiency** **:** Demonstrated English language proficiency, including ability to speak, read, write, and understand English well enough to meet minimally acceptable performance standards set for job duties.

**Motor Vehicle Driver License** **:** A Motor Vehicle Driver license, valid in New York State, may be required for some, but not all positions.

**Note:** CUNY considers full-time work to be at least 35 hours per week. Part-time experience of at least 20 hours per week may be prorated by half and credited instead of,but not in addition to, full-time experience during the same period (e.g., two months of related work experience at 20-34 hours per week equates to one month of full-time related work experience.) Part-time experience of fewer than 20 hours per week **cannot** be credited at all.

**OTHER QUALIFICATIONS**

Preferred:

* Extensive experience designing, engineering, and supporting large-scale, highly available enterprise networks, including routing, switching, WAN/MAN, wireless, datacenter, and network security technologies.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies and protocols, including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, IPv4/IPv6, QoS, and Metro Ethernet.
* Demonstrated experience with modern datacenter networking technologies, including spine-leaf architectures, VXLAN/EVPN, network virtualization, load balancing/application delivery, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Strong experience in network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code using technologies such as Python, Ansible, APIs, Git/source control, CI/CD pipelines, configuration templating, orchestration, and Zero-Touch Provisioning.
* Experience implementing enterprise security and Zero Trust networking principles, including segmentation/micro-segmentation, firewalls, identity-based network access, Cisco ISE, TACACS+/RADIUS, and secure administrative access.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise networking and security platforms such as Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and optical technologies; Palo Alto Networks firewalls; Infoblox DNS/DHCP/IPAM; and enterprise application delivery technologies.
* Experience with network observability, telemetry, packet analysis, performance management, and monitoring platforms such as ServiceNow, Datadog, SolarWinds, or comparable enterprise technologies.
* Experience supporting public and hybrid cloud networking, including private cloud connectivity, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, or comparable dedicated cloud connectivity services.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects and major incident response, develop architecture and engineering documentation, communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, and mentor technical staff.
